free_tier.stated: Free plan, USD 0: 200 API credits a day, 1 to 10 articles a credit, the past 48 hours of news with a 12-hour delay.
free_tier.notes: Most calls cost 1 credit; an Archive call costs 5 credits and a Count call 50. The pricing page says credits are deducted only for requests that are processed and return results, while the vendor's reference says a call that matches nothing still costs its credits. On the free plan the crypto and market endpoints cover the last 7 days with a 12-hour delay. The next plan up is Basic at USD 199.99 a month for 20,000 credits a month.

per_object_cap.stated: 1 to 10 articles a request on the free plan
per_object_cap.notes: The documentation gives 10 as the default and the largest page size on the free plan, size accepts 1 to 10, and a larger size answers HTTP 422. Unverified: behind a sign-up: how many articles a free call returns in practice.

retention.stated: the latest endpoint reaches the past 48 hours, with a 12-hour delay on the free plan

interface_detail: REST over HTTPS returning JSON; every endpoint is a GET except the WebSocket register call (POST) and the WebSocket delete call (DELETE); the key goes in the apikey parameter or the X-ACCESS-KEY header. The free plan also lists real-time streaming API access.
chaining: The free topical datasets on GitHub (CSV and JSON) are a no-key bulk start; the API adds the past 48 hours at 200 credits a day.

limits.value: 200 API credits a day on the free plan
30 requests every 15 minutes on the free plan, counted per account; a request over the limit answers HTTP 429 with the code RateLimitExceeded
1 to 10 articles a request on the free plan
rapid bursts of requests from a single IP address are limited separately from the 15-minute limit and answer HTTP 429 with the code TooManyRequests; the burst size is not stated

binding_note: 200 credits a day is the ceiling, and 30 requests every 15 minutes paces how fast it can be spent.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up form asks for a full name, an email and a password, each marked required, and offers an optional purpose and an optional phone number, or Google sign-in; the form's script checks a phone number only when one is entered and leaves it out of the sign-up request when the field is empty, and the request carries a reCAPTCHA response. Verifying the email address activates the account. No card for the free plan. Unverified: behind a sign-up: whether the sign-up server accepts a request with no phone number.

reliability_note: Over the 15-minute rate limit the API answers Rate Limit Exceeded and no data comes back for 15 minutes; a keyless call answered HTTP 401 with Retry-After 900.
confidence_note: Quota, rate, page size and sign-up fields are read from first-party pages; a keyless API call answered HTTP 401, so the free key was not exercised. One free dataset archive (9374054 bytes) downloaded from GitHub with no account.
